title: Overhauled
description: Overhauled is a Minecraft modpack that add more sounds, structures, mobs, and biomes to your game.
body:
Overhauled is a Minecraft modpack that enhances your gameplay by adding new sounds, structures, biomes, mobs, and more. It also includes numerous quality-of-life and performance improvements to meet your needs.

**Need better? Need Overhauled.**
